issue_context.title: 404 page when searching docs from project dashboard
issue_context.body:
# Bug report

<!-- 

⚠️ We receive a lot of bug reports which have already been solved or discussed. If you are looking for help, please try these first:

- Docs: https://docs.supabase.com
- Discussions: https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions
- Discord: https://discord.supabase.com

Before opening a bug report, please verify the following: 

-->

- [x] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. 
- [x] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). 

## Describe the bug

Searching the docs and clicking a result while working on a project on app.supabase.com leads to a 404.

## To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior, please provide code snippets or a repository:

1. Go to your project dashboard on app.supabase.com
2. Click the magnifying glass icon to do a search
3. Type "webhooks" in the search bar and press Enter
4. Selecting any search results leads to a 404 page

## Expected behavior

Search result links should not 404.

## Additional context

From what I can tell, the search results are accurate without the `app` subdomain.  For example, in my project dashboard if I search for *webhooks*

❌ `https://app.supabase.com/docs/guides/database/webhooks`

Removing the `app` subdomain from the 404 page takes me to the correct page.

✅ `https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/webhooks`
comments: @saltcod I'm still getting the same error.

review_comments: Why have the if statement if we are doing the same thing again with the `isLocal`?
first checks if the vars exist — if they don't, just uses supabase.com/docs. Possible someone might not have NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCAL_SUPABASE set in the docs env file
